guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in a list of ASE atoms objects including info and calculator results
guess_target_metadata: guess whether a target property is per-atom or per-image and whether it is intensive or extensive
target_per_atom: check if a target sample's first dimension is proportional to the number of atoms across samples
target_extensive: determine if a property scales with atom count by checking per-atom normalized standard deviation
target_constant_shape: check if all target samples have the same shape regardless of the number of atoms
